entries.subject: Selected source model
entries.finding: Geometry is the unchanged [ml14.obj](https://echo.jpl.nasa.gov/asteroids/shapes/ml14.obj) from the [NASA/JPL model index](https://echo.jpl.nasa.gov/asteroids/shapes/shapes.html), interpreted using [Ostro et al. (2001)](https://echo.jpl.nasa.gov/asteroids/1998ML14/ostro.etal.2001.1998ml14.pdf). This is the historical reconstruction from 1998 Goldstone/Arecibo radar and optical observations. It is not presented as the later shape reconstruction announced from 2013 observations. Shape uses the shared missing-imagery grid. Elevation is radius minus the documented reference sphere, derived from the same radar inverse model; it is not independent topography, optical albedo or height above a gravitational equipotential. Cartographic relief is a prepared display treatment. Shadows are off by default. Optional directional shading and the grid are existing shared rendering treatments, not measured surface appearance. The live JPL index was checked against the actual preparation input shape/ml14.obj; it still links this exact model. The page is dated 2024-08-10, not a new scientific-model release. This confirms the published source route, not new mesh bytes, optical imagery or independent source-fit accuracy.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: No calibrated registered optical mosaic, composition map or independent topographic raster was acquired. No generic regolith texture is substituted.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Sharkey 2016 reconstruction from 2013 radar
entries.finding: The 2001 radar reconstruction did not determine an inertial pole and fitted 14.83 ± 0.15 h. Later 2013 photometry found 14.28 ± 0.01 h; a 2016 abstract reports an updated shape/pole solution, whose numeric mesh was not acquired. The abstract download changed PDF trailer IDs and the original AAS route returned HTTP 403, so it is a surveyed reference rather than a reproducible pinned input.
entries.revisitWhen: Acquire the numerical reconstruction announced in the 2016 abstract, its coordinate definitions and spin solution; an accessible abstract alone does not replace the older mesh.

entries.subject: Warner photometry and JPL 2013 observing plan
entries.finding: The original JPL model and paper, Warner photometry, JPL 2013 observing plan and Horizons responses are pinned. The plan’s older 14.98 h catalogue value is not substituted for the newer 14.28 ± 0.01 h photometric measurement.

entries.subject: LPI 2013 radar images
entries.finding: The LPI entry identifies observational radar images; its direct download returned HTTP 403 in the recorded survey. It is a reference, not an acquired input. Delay-Doppler panels and light curves do not themselves provide registered optical surface texels.
entries.revisitWhen: An accessible authoritative copy establishes the product contents and any numerical model or calibrated camera/map data it actually supplies.
